item.title: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered is the only remaster Pipeworks can confirm for now, but "a lot of stuff is on the table," and there are "a lot of conversations to be had" in the future.
item.description: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered is the only remaster Pipeworks can confirm for now, but "a lot of stuff is on the table," and there are "a lot of conversations to be had" in the future. The developer behind the November upgrade and the 2002 game it's based on opened up about the potential for more games in the series during an all-encompassing interview with IGN. With Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee officially coming back, the natural question we and everyone else had is: Will we be getting remasters for Godzilla: Save the Earth and Godzilla: Unleashed? According to senior designer Simon Strange, it's too soon to say, but that doesn't mean he isn't rooting for it to happen. "Let me tell you, I had that desire long before we announced this game, so I get it," Strange said. "I want to do all that stuff, too. I mean, all that stuff is now technically possible."

item.title: Amazon MGM Studios' new Tomb Raider series broke health and safety laws during production, just months after filming had to be halted due to star Sophie Turner's on-set injury.
item.description: Amazon MGM Studios' new Tomb Raider series broke UK health and safety laws during production, it's emerged, just months after filming had to be halted due to star Sophie Turner sustaining an injury on set. In a separate incident, the production was found to have failed its "biological monitoring" duties regarding the use of potentially hazardous chemicals — isocyanate paints, which can cause asthma attacks. Isocyanate paints require appropriate equipment to be worn during use and must be handled by properly protected staff, with the air then given up to 20 minutes to clear afterwards. Deadline reports that this was not adhered to on the Tomb Raider set, and the UK's Heath and Safety Executive (HSE) was forced to intervene. The production was later confirmed to have broken the Health and Safety At Work Act 1974 and Control of Substances Hazardous to Health Regulations 2002. Despite the UK's non-stop use as a filming destination, just four HSE interventions have taken place over the past four years, making this a noteworthy occurrence — particularly for such a high-profile series.

item.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 developer Infinity Ward has announced that the playable beta for the next first-person shooter in the long-running franchise has been extended until 10pm PT tonight/1am ET tomorrow morning.
item.description: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 developer Infinity Ward has announced that the playable beta for the next first-person shooter in the long-running franchise has been extended until 10pm PT tonight/1am ET tomorrow morning. "A little more time on the clock," the studio posted on its X account. We see you grinding out those Beta Rewards and camos, so we’re giving you some extra time. The #MW4 Open Beta is extended until 10 PM PT tonight. 2XP + Double Weapon XP stay active until close. Enjoy!" Infinity Ward has already updated the beta, most recently to address TTK criticisms and tweak the weapons, but they also pushed changes out to beta testers last week as well. It's been an unusual beta this year in the sense that a fan-favorite character's haircut has been the subject of some controversy, and the beta also included a single-player mission for the first time ever.

item.title: Ryan Murphy's dark and disturbing series - drops a new poster, episode titles and short synopses for installments 4-6.
item.description: Someone over at Hulu decided to lock in on the social media campaign for American Horror Story 13 — the latest in Ryan Murphy's dark and disturbing series — dropping a new poster, episode titles and short synopses for installments 4–6. The poster is classic Murphy, featuring a figure in a full black latex gimp suit, brandishing a giant black sunflower. Several characters have rocked the outfit — also known as the Rubber Man costume — throughout previous seasons, most notably Tate Langdon (played by Evan Peters in American Horror Story: Murder House). That makes sense, as Murphy told Vogue that 13 would see some of the show's most popular characters return. "I just thought the number 13 was infused with so much stuff in the horror genre, and I wanted to do a greatest hits season," Murphy said. The episode titles listed are:

item.title: A new chapter from the world of Project Hail Mary is being released as a VR game this fall.
item.description: A new chapter from the world of Project Hail Mary is being released as a VR game this fall. Developer Maze Theory is producing a new VR/mixed reality title known as Project Hail Mary: Journey Among the Stars, which will tell an original new story in the sci-fi world. Players will step into the shoes of Ryland Grace (who appears to be a silent protagonist this time around) and work together with Rocky to diagnose and solve problems on your ship. It's unclear how long this game will be or how expansive it is, but it looks like a fun way for fans to get more Project Hail Mary content (and more Rocky). The game will see actor James Ortiz reprising his role as the voice of Rocky, who expressed a lot of excitement in returning to the character for this game. “Playing Rocky again for the game has been really special," said Ortiz. "Fans will be able to step inside the world of Project Hail Mary, interact with Rocky using the same character model from the film, and experience a completely new part of his journey with Grace. It is as close as you can get to the cinematic experience, but this time you are inside it.”

item.title: No Rest for the Wicked developer Moon Studios has delayed the game's long-awaited 1.0 launch until March 2027.
item.description: No Rest for the Wicked developer Moon Studios has delayed the game's long-awaited 1.0 launch until March 2027. The news was confirmed today alongside a fresh trailer for the game, and an explanation that the wait would bring improved gameplay performance, a tightened class system and further polish to make the action RPG finally hit version 1.0 at "the standard it deserves." If it feels like we've been waiting a long time for No Rest for the Wicked version 1.0, then that's because its initial PC early access build arrived back in April 2024. When the game does hit 1.0 in March 2027, it will do so for PlayStation 5 and PC. Nintendo Switch 2 and Xbox Series X/S versions are still planned, but lack a formal launch date. As a reward for players' patience, the game's Founders Pack of extra in-game items has been extended to anyone who purchases the game before January 1, 2027, with recent purchases now retroactively included in the offer. That's for PC players, to be clear, while PS5 pre-order customers will get a similar offer early next year.

item.title: We got to speak with one of the developers behind Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest, who opened up about the team’s creative process and what it’s like bringing the Clans to life.
item.description: Erin Hunter’s Warrior Cats franchise is finally getting an officially licensed video game coming to all major platforms this fall. We got to speak with one of the developers behind the turn-based title, who opened up about the team’s creative process and what it’s like bringing the Clans to life. As a lifelong fan of the Warrior Cats world, I couldn’t believe it when I got the chance to quiz the developers at Bamtang Games and the folks at Coolabi Group about Clans of the Forest, the upcoming turn-based role-playing game based on the four original clans of the Warriors book series. I also get to be the one to happily break the news of its official launch date. Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest will release on October 23, 2026 on PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X and S, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2. With that out of the way, let’s take a dive into my conversation with Adam Johnston, Creative Director at Bamtang Games, who assured me that his team is doing everything they can to stay true the the books’ lore — even to the point of bringing in community members to keep them on the right path.

Ubisoft just revealed a remake of 1999's Heroes of Might and Magic 3 at Gamescom, and one look at the trailer shows it goes far beyond a simple polish and port. Set to release in 2027 across console and PC, the new game will swap the original's isometric 2D view with a 3D world and add new content - a fresh prologue campaign and some fancy cinematics - and tweak the original mechanics to make the game more accessible, without diluting the gameplay. IGN spoke to Jean-Felix Monin, Creative Director at Ubisoft China, about the project and how the still very dedicated Heroes of Might and Magic 3 fanbase has been a key part of shaping this new version. "I would say for us, the intention behind this game was really, there's this community, there's this great game that people have been kind of asking for a remake of for years now, and so we really want to do right by them," he said. "We had contact with some key people in the community, people that we had worked with on other transmedia stuff, such as the board game, people that we knew we trusted and were quite representative and well-known, and they came and did some consulting."

item.title: Just last week, Nvidia's controversial DLSS 5 technology leaked when a DLL file was found in the NBA 2K27 beta. It shouldn't be too surprising, then, that the technology will be officially launching on September 3 in, well, NBA 2K27.
item.description: Just last week, Nvidia's controversial DLSS 5 technology leaked when a DLL file was found in the NBA 2K27 beta. It shouldn't be too surprising, then, that the technology will be officially launching on September 3 in, well, NBA 2K27. Nvidia bills DLSS 5 as a 3D-bound neural rendering technique, which takes geometry and color data from the game you're playing, and then draws an AI-generated image on top of the rendered frame. The goal is to maximize photorealism, without the massive computational cost that would require in more traditional methods. Nvidia insists that because the model is constrained by the geometry and color information in the original scene, that it won't add extra elements to the scene or misplace objects. But that's something I'll have to test when the tech becomes available Thursday. Regardless of the aesthetic changes that DLSS 5 has in games, it doesn't come for free. While some of the mods that materialized after the leak on Friday had some massive performance hits, I assumed that was partly because of a lack of optimization. However, even according to Nvidia, enabling the DLSS 5 neural renderer in NBA 2K27 will hit performance by around 50–60%. Although, it will have a noticeable impact on how the game looks. To offset that performance hit, Nvidia encourages folks to enable the other parts of the DLSS software suite, like super resolution and frame generation to keep your frame rate high. The technology will also only work on RTX 5000 graphics cards at launch, but I'd recommend only enabling it if you have an RTX 5070 or better.

item.title: The Witcher 3 developer CD Projekt has confirmed you'll be able to use your existing save files with the game's upcoming Remastered edition — and provided detail on Achievements and Trophies, too.
item.description: The Witcher 3 developer CD Projekt has confirmed you'll be able to use your existing save files with the game's generous upcoming Remastered edition — and provided detail on Achievements and Trophies, too. Writing today via a post on X/Twitter, the studio said it had seen a number of fan questions over the game's forthcoming new edition, which will be awarded to existing owners of the game. This is even the case for Nintendo Switch owners upgrading to a copy of Remastered on Nintendo Switch 2, and free on all platforms. "Good news: your current saves will work with the upgrade, so you can get back on the Path right where you left off," CD Projekt wrote. This is great news for lapsed fans who still haven't seen everything The Witcher 3 has to offer (and there is a lot on offer). And, of course, it's worth remembering that the base game now includes access to its two expansions, Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine. You'll want to play both of those before the RPG's belated third expansion, Songs of the Past, launches in 2027.

item.title: YouTuber MrBeast has co-written a novel — but the book has reportedly performed poorly in pre-order sales.
item.description: UPDATE: IGN has received fresh publishing information on MrBeast's book from a senior-level source with knowledge of the numbers, disputing the narrative that the project is on track to "bomb." Indeed, presale figures are "beyond four digits" and "tracking well for a debut novel," IGN has been told. It's also understood that the marketing strategy for MrBeast's book is not focused specificially on driving pre-orders, as it's believed that the YouTube mega star's younger audience will likely pick up the novel after publication day — which is today. The Most Dangerous Games is available, priced $35 for a hardcover copy. More details on its plot can be found in our original story, below. ORIGINAL STORY: YouTube star Jimmy Donaldson, better known as MrBeast, has co-written a novel — but the book has reportedly performed poorly in pre-order sales.

item.title: Game of Thrones star Kit Harrington has given a disappointing update on the future of his Marvel character Dane Whitman, better known as Black Knight.
item.description: Game of Thrones star Kit Harington has given a disappointing update on the future of his Marvel character Dane Whitman, better known as Black Knight. Harrington joined the MCU as part of an extraordinarily starry cast in the 2021 sci-fi blockbuster Eternals. But despite Eternal's end credits promising that its superhero team would return, no mention has been made of the characters since, following the film's poor critical and commercial performance. Marvel boss Kevin Feige admitted back in 2022 that there are no plans for an Eternals 2 at the current time, and there's been zero word to suggest this has changed in the meantime. But perhaps more than any other character in the Eternals, fans have long held onto hope that Harington could still reprise his role someday — if not in a full sequel then perhaps in another project. Fans have long wanted Marvel to announce a Midnight Sons team-up movie, and still hold hope one may materialize eventually. Not only could Harington return without the rest of the Eternals, it would also be a neat place to feature Ryan Gosling's Ghost Rider following his introduction. And hey, Mahershala Ali's Blade could appear there too!

item.title: Psychonauts and Costume Quest maker Double Fine has launched its new game development Kickstarter project after cutting ties with Xbox, and says it'll make Brütal Legend 2 if it raises an impossible-sounding $100 million.
item.description: Psychonauts and Costume Quest maker Double Fine has launched its new game development Kickstarter project after cutting ties with Xbox, and says it'll make Brütal Legend 2 if it raises an impossible-sounding $100 million. Double Fine is crowdfunding support for its new game jam on Kickstarter, the platform it previously used to successfully fund Broken Age, long before its recently-concluded stint as an Xbox-owned studio, and subsequent layoffs affecting 25% of its team. With the Microsoft money pipe now severed, the maker of recent titles such as Kiln and Keeper must now fund its own experimental indie projects. And so, once again, it is holding a two-week stint of creating a series of bizarre prototypes, which fans of the company can choose to vote on and support. At the time of writing, Double Fine's crowdfunding campaign has raised just over $275,000 of its current $400,000 goal, with 29 days still to go. It remains to be seen what further stretch goals will be added to the project as its progress continues, though the company has already promised it will develop a Brütal Legend sequel should it hit $100 million.

item.title: Bit Reactor, the studio behind Star Wars Zero Company, furloughed the majority of its staff just before the game launched.
item.description: Bit Reactor, the studio behind Star Wars Zero Company, furloughed the majority of its staff just before the game launched. Critically praised and currently a bestseller on Steam, Star Wars Zero Company looked to have had a brilliant launch — though the celebrations have now been marred by word of what has happened to the people who made it. A Game File report has now highlighted comments made by Zachariah Scott, a former Bit Reactor employee, who claimed the company was "concealing the fact that the team was furloughed weeks ago" — while its CEO Greg Foertsch was busy at Gamescom last week talking about the team's next game. While Bit Reactor has since confirmed to Game File many of its staff are now on furlough, the exact numbers of people involved are unclear. The report's suggestion is that 80% of the studio have currently been placed on leave without pay, leaving behind a small number of staff to deal with any post-launch bugs. It's believed that Bit Reactor ran out of money to pay employees shortly before launch, despite hopes of landing another game deal, and a push to keep costs down with "austerity."

item.title: IGN Australia and Chupa Chups to Host a Retro Gaming ‘Fun House’ Activation at Westfield Parramatta This October
item.description: Looking for some free fun October 1 to 4? Chupa Chups is teaming up with IGN Australia and Westfield Parramatta for four days of free gaming goodness this October school holidays. We're calling it the “Chupa Chups Forever Fun House” - and Aussie IGNers are invited to come check out our 90s family dream home: four decorated rooms, loads of consoles and games, free Chupa Chups lollies and daily prize giveaways! Doors open as soon as Westfield does - and it lasts all day until close, so come along and check it out. Did we mention it’s free? So what’s on show? We’ll have instant multiplayer party-makers like Mario Kart World, Super Smash Bros Ultimate and Minecraft Dungeons II.

item.title: Verdict arrives 30 years after the rapper and actor was killed in a Las Vegas drive-by shooting.
item.description: Duane “Keffe D” Davis has been found guilty of the 1996 murder of rapper and actor Tupac Shakur, reports ABC News. The verdict came after less than three hours of deliberation from the jury. Davis was charged with one count of first-degree murder with a deadly weapon with the intent to promote, further, or assist a criminal gang. It was not argued by prosecutors that the now 63-year-old Davis fired the weapon that killed Shakur in the September 7, 1996 drive-by shooting near the Las Vegas Strip, but rather that he orchestrated the event and gave the gun to the shooter in their vehicle. It’s alleged Davis’ nephew Orlando Anderson, or another man in the backseat of the car, carried out the shooting. Anderson was killed in a reportedly unrelated 1998 gang shootout at a Compton, California car wash. “For nearly 18 years, Duane Davis has told the police, television, books, YouTube interviewers – anybody that will listen, he has told – he is responsible for the murder of Tupac Shakur,” prosecutor Binu Palal told the jury. “Tell him you hear him – find him guilty.” Davis is facing life in prison as a possible maximum sentence.

item.title: AMC Theaters isn’t merely a destination for watching new film releases; it now helps make those releases happen.
item.description: AMC Theaters isn’t merely a destination for watching new film releases; it now helps make those releases happen. Launched on August 31, 2026, AMC has rolled out Leawood Films, its very own movie distribution label that aims to bring small or mid-sized movies to the big screen that have been completely financed and finished. Speaking in a press release, AMC Entertainment chairman and CEO Adam Aron cited moviegoers’ increasing appetites for independent films. “Ultimately, moviegoers consistently demonstrate their appetite for a wide variety of theatrical content, and we believe there are more outstanding films that deserve the opportunity to find audiences on the big screen,” he said. “Through Leawood Films, we believe we can bring meaningful value to filmmakers whose movies might otherwise not get made, or which might not be taken to theatres.

item.title: Former DC movie star Gal Gadot has opened up about the confusion surrounding Wonder Woman 3, saying that, even though it "wasn't handled elegantly," it's "all good" between her, James Gunn, and Peter Safran.
item.description: Former DC movie star Gal Gadot has opened up about the confusion surrounding Wonder Woman 3, saying that, even though it "wasn't handled elegantly," it's "all good" between her, James Gunn, and Peter Safran. The story of Wonder Woman 3 is a bit of a mess. Gadot's return was seemingly greenlit, canceled, greenlit again, and, finally, canceled in the early 2020s, with its supposed early days unfortunately weighed down by leadership changes behind the scenes as Gunn and Safran stepped in to take over the DC movie business. One of the stranger updates during the kerfuffle saw the actress confirm the two superhero film execs had told her she would come back as Diana Prince for Wonder Woman 3 before it was reported that Gunn and Safran didn't have any plans for a third movie from director Patty Jenkins after all. It was a back-and-forth painful enough to watch from the outside, but it was probably even more grueling on the inside. Gadot recalled the confusion during an interview with Happy, Sad, Confused. She again confirmed that Gunn and Safran assured her Wonder Woman 3 was happening, going as far as to say that there was never a clear moment when the project was formally canned.

item.title: PlayStation users may be eligible for a cut of a $7.85 million class-action lawsuit settlement very soon.
item.description: PlayStation users may be eligible for a cut of a $7.85 million class-action lawsuit settlement very soon. The class-action lawsuit, Caccuri v. Sony Interactive Entertainment, alleged that Sony violated anti-trust laws by forcing "consumers to pay more for certain digital games than they otherwise would have paid on the PlayStation Store.” It did so by removing digital vouchers for games from third-party retailers like Amazon or key resellers, meaning if you want a digital copy of a PlayStation game, you must buy it directly from the PlayStation Store. This move removed the freedom of choice for a lot of players and has only become a hotter topic in recent months, as PlayStation plans to exit the physical media market in 2028. The lawsuit alleges that this decision pushed customers into paying more for games through the PlayStation Store. Sony denied any wrongdoing and pushed back against claims that members were damaged by its actions. The court also hasn't decided if the company actually violated any laws yet, but it has preliminarily approved a $7.85 million settlement, subject to a final approval hearing on October 15. That hearing will decide how the funds will be distributed, lock in the final sum, and pay out attorney fees. For further updates, you can check out the official settlement website.

item.title: An indie game where players share heartbeats with their pet cat, which can transform into a giant kitty big enough to ride on and defeat enemies, is going viral — and it’s not hard to see why.
item.description: An indie game where players share heartbeats with their pet cat, which can transform into a giant kitty big enough to ride on and defeat enemies, is going viral — and it’s not hard to see why. The game, titled Ylem’s Cat, is the debut offering of a small, independent studio based in Guangzhou, China. It was first revealed at gamescom this year, and it’s already sweeping across social media. Per its listing on Steam, the game’s official logline is as follows: “Ylem’s Cat is an action-adventure game driven by the bond between a girl and her cat. Led by curiosity and knowledge, Molly sets out on a journey to find her missing mother across a dying planet, exploring ruins and uncovering the truth buried within the giants.” While the game’s graphics are truly stunning and its gameplay loop seems immersive enough, the cat is the real selling point here. It can join you in combat and bop enemies on the head, and you can even use the reflection from your bow to play with it like a laser pointer. The feline’s realistic behavior will no doubt be a selling point for cat lovers (but we have to warn you that it does seem like it falls into mortal peril at one point in the trailer).
